observations.statement: Seed 9379992 selects zero-primal-entry arches (31,22) on the SAT seed and (22,13) on the UNSAT seed; adding them between consecutive copies yields connected graph families with exact theta 8r and opposite alpha labels relative to 8r.
The arch construction proves that disconnectedness is not necessary for the first-theta collision, but the added graph edges are not yet shown to preserve standard CNF conflict-graph realizability.

H102 is destroyed because its explicit original-variable circuit with decomposable AND and deterministic OR gates is a d-DNNF of the same size, so unconditional DNNF lower bounds transfer without projection.
H100 is rejected because its potential language and prohibition on a global acceptance channel are undefined and do not exclude local work-tape simulation with a decreasing clock.

Clearing rational denominators and bounding fraction-free elimination minors by Hadamard gives a candidate polynomial bit bound for exact rational LDL certificates, narrowing H092 to independent verification of the pivoted minor identities.

A strict bounded-norm graph-dual witness can be rounded to a polynomial-bit dyadic witness while preserving half the PSD and objective margins; the missing question for H097 is whether a suitable multiplier bound follows from its original promises.
C014 uses seed 9379992 only for deterministic artifact selection and stress generation; every accepted result is subsequently verified exactly and is independent of probability.
After two terminal removals and six descendants, the live inventory rises from ninety-three to ninety-seven and terminal historical nodes rise from ten to twelve.
